dedupe_keys.name: hilarri hydropower infrastructure lakes reservoirs and rivers linkage database ornl

description: HILARRI is an Oak Ridge National Laboratory database of links between major datasets of operational hydropower dams and powerplants and inland water bodies, published on the DOE Data Explorer in September 2024. It connects dams from the National Inventory of Dams (2024) and the Global Reservoir and Dam Database, and hydropower plants from the Existing Hydropower Assets dataset (2024), to National Hydrography Dataset products, HydroLAKES, LAGOS-US lakes, EPA National Lakes Assessment and the Reservoir Sedimentation Database, using unique identifiers so users can join to the original full datasets. HILARRI holds only identifiers, location and data quality or usage notes, not the attributes or time series of the linked sites, and it adds flags for dams that may no longer exist, dams listed more than once and uncertain hydropower operation. Coverage is the United States, with global reservoirs from one linked source. Access: DOE Data Explorer with DOI 10.21951/HILARRI/2474802, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: it is a linkage table, not a plant attribute database. It suits hydropower and water system analysis, and relates to the ORNL environmental flow requirements record catalogued here.
